verdict.rationale: The only documented multi-item operation is the Local Search POI endpoints, whose `ids` parameter fetches details for up to 20 location IDs in a single request. That is a narrow batch lookup on one endpoint, not a general bulk-operations capability. No batch search queries or bulk jobs are documented. Missing for 10: batch/multi-query search requests, bulk operations across other endpoints (web, news, image, LLM context), documented batch job or async bulk processing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The ids query parameter accepts up to 20 location IDs
To fetch AI-generated descriptions for locations: curl "https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/local/descriptions?ids=..."
